My sorghum plot is small, only a tiny strip of my family's land, so I must be careful with how I spend money. I have some schooling and I know fertilizer helps, but cash is tight, so I will buy only a small amount of DAP and urea from the cooperative and use manure from our animals to stretch it. I will plant the local sorghum seed we saved from last year because improved sorghum seed is hard to find here and I trust the local variety for our rains. My husband and I will do most of the work ourselves with the ox-plough, and I may ask a neighbor to help briefly at weeding.
